sources: recreation.gov search API (q='Barron Creek', campgrounds): no listing, read 2026-10-22

values.note: Seven sites: the 3 in the open area (fire rings, vault toilet nearby) accommodate up to a 40-ft RV; the 4 in the boat-dock parking area have a vault toilet nearby. Paved campground road; parking spurs and loops are native material.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/kootenai/recreation/barron-creek-boating-site ('This camping area has seven sites. The 3 sites in the open area ... are able to accommodate up to a 40' rv. The 4 sites in the boat dock parking area have a vault toilet nearby. Campground road and boat ramp are paved, parking spurs and loops are of native material'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Fully developed boat ramp with dock. Pack in/pack out.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/kootenai/recreation/barron-creek-boating-site ('Vault toilet(s)', 'Potable water is not available at this site', 'a fully developed boat ramp with dock', '$0.00 Pack in/Pack out'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Forest Service: 'The campground and boat ramp are managed from Memorial Day through Labor Day, but is available all year to visitors. Access is dependent upon weather conditions.'
No reservation channel: the Forest Service page offers none and recreation.gov has no listing. 14-day stay limit on National Forest System lands.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/kootenai/recreation/barron-creek-boating-site ('14 day stay limit on National Forest System Lands'; no reservation link) + recreation.gov search API (no Barron Creek facility), read 2026-10-22

note: Kootenai NF boating site on the west shore of Lake Koocanusa, about 25 mi NE of Libby via FDR 228. The 3 open-area sites (fire rings) are the ones that take an RV; the other 4 are in the boat-dock parking area. Paved road and boat ramp with dock; native-surface spurs. --Claude
summary: Forest Service (Kootenai NF) site, free, first-come (no reservation channel; not on recreation.gov). Confirmed $0 pack-in/pack-out, 7 sites to 40 ft, vault toilets, no potable water, open all year (managed Memorial Day-Labor Day), 14-day limit. No current alert names FDR 228 or the site. Note trimmed of restated values.
